drawing: Single bed 900x2000 (metal slatted base 13, 2000x900, on its own legs, dropped inside the frame). Headboard 1 (962 wide x 848 high), footboard 2 (962 x 300), side rails 3 (2008 long x 198 high, 2) between head- and footboard with corner brackets 8 (4, screws 4x25) + Direkta 7x70 (4) — rails join the inner faces of head/foot boards (рис. 1). Decorative frame 4 (957x340) screwed (4x40, 12) onto the upper part of headboard 1, front face. 5 glides on the bottom edges of parts 1 and 2. Inner width 962 - 2x16 ≈ 930 wide for 900 base (approx.); overall length ≈ 2008 + 2 board thicknesses. No front view, no dimension lines (perspective only).
